apps.name: openGym Plus
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of openGym with extra features: a Health area with Apple Health and RENPHO, a music bar, machine settings and photos per exercise, health widgets on Home, Settings as a tab. Not affiliated with the original project. AGPL-3.0-or-later; source at github.com/TheBlackSide243/openGym.
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker

apps.name: Wardrowbe
apps.localizedDescription: The Wardrowbe site full screen, sharing photos from other apps, a widget with today's outfit and the weather (with an "I wore it" button from iOS 17), photos without their background, shortcuts to Selfie and What to buy. It connects to your own Wardrowbe server.
apps.subtitle: Your wardrobe, on your own server

apps.name: TrackLap
apps.localizedDescription: Lap, sector and live delta timing from GPS, for track days: any ESP32 with Bluetooth and a GPS (firmware installed from the browser at esp32.tbsgaming.win, with a dashboard on the Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47, and g-forces from the accelerometer of its Touch version), the iPhone's own GPS, or a simulated car to try it right away. Worldwide track search as you type, a catalog of 60+ famous circuits and a satellite editor for the start line and sectors. Lap analysis inspired by RaceChrono: compare with any lap or your track record, one cursor across map and charts, corner speeds, where you gain and lose, sectors and a friction circle; voice lap times, GPX and CSV export. With friends: chase a friend's lap shared as a file, live groups with standings and gaps on track, online leaderboards for every circuit. Drag mode like a performance meter: 0-100, quarter mile, rolling 80-120 and 100-0 braking with a one-press start, records and the ESP32 dashboard. Picking a track places the start line and sectors by themselves, from the finish line OpenStreetMap marks where it has one. Your garage: every car with its photo, power, weight and modifications, public at a link of its own, and on the leaderboards each time shows the car and whether it came from an external GPS or the iPhone. Setups for every car, for the wet and the dry, with every earlier version kept and each session remembering the one it was driven with; Live offers the wet one when it rains at the track. Setups never go online: they leave the phone only as a file you export. In Italian, English, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese.
apps.subtitle: GPS lap timer for the track
